rule.message:
At least 17 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s Liberal Education requirements . Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

For more information on how to transfer into CBS please visit our website here:
https://cbs.umn.edu/future-students/transferring-cbs Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
